commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Dennis Man (Parma) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Jean Butez makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal.
90+1' PENALTY APPEAL by Parma, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
86' A substitution has been made. Simon Sohm (Parma) is replaced by Dennis Man.
85' Here is a change. Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) is going off and Christian Chivu gives the last tactical orders to Milan Djuric.
84' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jonathan Ikone (Como) as he is replaced by Alieu Fadera.
83' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Mergim Vojvoda will be replaced by Ignace Van der Brempt (Como).
83' Substitution. Yannik Engelhardt on for Maxence Caqueret (Como).
79' 0 - 1 Goal! Anastasios Douvikas plays a pass to the feet of Gabriel Strefezza (Como), and he shoots into the bottom right corner from inside the box. It's 0:1.
74' Gabriel Strefezza comes onto the pitch because Lucas Da Cunha (Como) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mateo Pellegrino leaves the pitch and Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) comes on.
73' A substitution has been made. Antoine Hainaut (Parma) goes off and Drissa Camara comes on.
73' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

72' Jonathan Ikone (Como) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal!
70' Como have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
67' Antoine Hainaut (Parma) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
65' Como failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
65' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Como will take a corner.
64' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle after Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
63' Jonathan Ikone (Como) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Zion Suzuki, who smothers the ball.
59' Antoine Hainaut plays a beautiful lofted pass to Mateo Pellegrino (Parma), who somehow crashes the ball well wide of the left post from a promising position.
56' Cesc Fabregas has decided to substitute Patrick Cutrone (Como) and he is replaced by Anastasios Douvikas.
54' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
52' A cross from the corner kick arrives close to the penalty spot. Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
52' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) is about to take a corner kick.

51' Antoine Hainaut (Parma) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Parma.
51' Jean Butez blocks a long-range effort from Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) towards the roof of the net.
48' The Parma players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.

42' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the bottom right corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
42' Maxence Caqueret (Como) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
42' Nico Paz (Como) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. It will be a corner kick for Como.
40' The corner is swung in but Parma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
37' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
34' Nico Paz (Como) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Marco Di Bello who sees an offensive foul.
30' Patrick Cutrone (Como) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
29' That's a well-taken pass by Jonathan Ikone (Como). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
27' A pass from Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is intercepted by Zion Suzuki and the move breaks down.
26' Jonathan Ikone (Como) was too forceful with his tackle and Marco Di Bello interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
26' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
21' Nico Paz (Como) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
20' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
20' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
20' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
20' Como take a quick free kick with a short pass and play continues.
18' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
18' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Como have a free kick.
17' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
15' Maxence Caqueret (Como) is flagged for offside.
14' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is penalised for a foul. Marco Di Bello had a clear view and blows his whistle.
12' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
11' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends a cross into the box, but Jean Butez comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
8' The ball goes out of play and Parma have been awarded a corner kick.

8' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Parma.
7' Parma have been awarded a corner kick.
7' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out of play. Parma are awarded a corner kick.
6' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Parma have been awarded a free kick.
5' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Mergim Vojvoda (Como) takes it short.
3' Maximo Perrone (Como) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
2' Nico Paz (Como) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Zion Suzuki intercepts the ball.

1' A cross to the edge of the box finds Patrick Cutrone (Como) who takes a nice first touch and tries to beat the keeper with quick shot towards the bottom left corner. Zion Suzuki pulls off a good save and the score remains the same.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Parma will have the kick-off.
Marco Di Bello will officiate today.
